name: adblocker
description: One plugin for what Clear Glass does with a page's elements: Ad blocking (filter lists, element hiding, allowed sites, your own filters — as before), the Guardian picker (point at an element, then gate it or bind a key to it), ErosmancerOS (its state) and editing ErosmancerOS's TypeScript yourself (export a copy, show your changes, import them: syntax checked, old files kept, its own test run). Was the Ad Blocker (2.1.0); the same plugin, so your lists and settings stay.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
